findings.title: LAlt Tab tap with explicit None hold still activates navigation
findings.reproduction: SOURCE-ONLY, not executed AHK: choose left_alt tap_action=tab and hold None (serialized hold_modifier="", inherited hold_layer evicted), then hold LAlt and press a nav-bound letter. lalt.ahk special Tab criterion matches without testing hold_layer and calls TapHoldOwnImmediateLayer. Long LAlt emits no Tab. source-checks.cjs asserts exact production source and negative controls.
findings.root_cause: Special LAlt Tab hotkey omits a nonempty hold_layer criterion while unconditionally entering the layer helper; generic tap-only excludes Tab as special, so None cannot fall back to tap-only.
findings.silent_failure: Picker persists and shows no hold, yet non-native nav layer activates. Default Backspace+nav and shared default/catalogue gates do not exercise this custom combination.
findings.regression_test: On Windows capture/evaluate actual LAlt registration criteria across Tab x None/nav/Ctrl; invoke winner through hold ownership seams and assert None never activates nav. Include custom RCtrl+LAlt path and other special tap/hold combinations.

findings.title: Composer Save-and-use treats pending selection launch as completed active layout
findings.reproduction: SOURCE-ONLY, not executed AHK: with another layout selected, Save-and-use a valid composition; allow selection reload to launch then refuse later terminal handoff. LayoutManager_Select returns true for pending, composer immediately publishes used=true; scoped gateway later rolls config back without a composer terminal callback. source-checks.cjs asserts actual branches and already-selected negative control.
findings.root_cause: Unselected composer use branch consumes bool API LayoutManager_Select that conflates pending/committed receipts, instead of retaining terminal receipt/callback as the already-selected refresh branch does.
findings.silent_failure: Shared page marks composition active and clears busy before runtime replacement commits; a later refusal leaves old runtime/config but no corrected composer result.
findings.regression_test: Use actual pending selection owner with later refusal/success and synchronous refusal; keep pending=true used=false until terminal completion and publish one final result after rollback/acknowledgement.
